4930:soul:2125.reviewedBy: Codex exact API and actual state verification
4930:soul:2125.rationale: 自身当前可触发金木火土及三项清除失败回复独立实现；完整登场、首次授予时序与异常奖励待答，不以场下条件豁免。
4930:soul:2125.singleBehavior: 只隔离未知初始授印的审计夹具验证已有金保5、木低概率阻止、免攻归零火土、唯一最高抗性100与忽略50%减伤、真实清除失败每项魂印回血100。完整原生登场明确抛Q001。
4930:soul:2125.deferredBehavior: 本人场下仍在出战背包时观察真实双方队伍PP/异常/攻击事件；敌方真实场下精灵指定在场目标触发水印并取消该场下定向效果；印记作为队伍状态跨换宠。
4930:soul:2125.trigger: 自身位于出战背包时；对方场下精灵指定场上精灵为效果目标时
futureMechanisms: 真实场下效果来源与指定目标

dependencyEvidence.quote: 对方场下精灵指定场上精灵为效果目标时

success.name: 4930金印已有且PP至少5时明确清PP保5并刷新5回，正常用招/扣减到0不触发；首清与低于5明确待答
success.assertion: test('4930金印已有且PP至少5时明确清PP保5并刷新5回，正常用招/扣减到0不触发；首清与低于5明确待答',()=>{const s=partialMake({move:38485,index:1});mark(s,0,'金',1);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.clearPP(c.t,key(38484));},()=>turn(s,38485,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38484)],5);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.fiveMarks2125.金.end,5);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38485)],4);turn(s,38484,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38484)],4);assert.throws(()=>observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.clearPP(c.t,key(38484));},()=>turn(s,38485,20117)),/Q-4930-002/);const p=partialMake({move:38485,index:1});assert.throws(()=>observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.clearPP(c.t,key(38484));},()=>turn(p,38485,20117)),/Q-4930-002/);p.fighters[0].pp[key(38485)]=1;turn(p,38485,20117);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].pp[key(38485)],0);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.fiveMarks2125.金,undefined);});

success.name: 4930已有木印阻止低概率异常并刷新，100%不挡；首发与封零资格明确分别待答
success.assertion: test('4930已有木印阻止低概率异常并刷新，100%不挡；首发与封零资格明确分别待答',()=>{for(const move of[10114,20020]){const s=partialMake({move:38485,index:1,enemySource:enemy,enemyLoadout:[10114,20020,20570,38467,29409]});mark(s,1,'木',1);turn(s,38485,move);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒'],move===20020);if(move===10114)assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.fiveMarks2125.木.end,5);}const p=partialMake({move:38485,index:1,enemySource:enemy,enemyLoadout:[10114,20020,20570,38467,29409]});assert.throws(()=>turn(p,38485,10114),/Q-4930-005/);mark(p,1,'木');p.fighters[1].soulState.bright2009=1;assert.throws(()=>turn(p,38485,10114),/Q-4853-007/);});

success.name: 4930火土印记实际红伤免疫归零触发，已有同种全场印记不新增种类；仅盾抵挡与MISS不触发
success.assertion: test('4930火土印记实际红伤免疫归零触发，已有同种全场印记不新增种类；仅盾抵挡与MISS不触发',()=>{const s=partialMake({move:38485,index:1});mark(s,1,'火土');timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(s,38485,20117);assert.equal(sum(s),0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.fiveMarks2125.火土.end,5);for(const mode of['shield','miss']){const p=partialMake({move:38485,index:1,hit:mode!=='miss'});if(mode==='shield')S.refresh(p.fighters[1],9000,'test');else timer(p,1,'概率闪避',{chance:100});turn(p,38485,20117);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.fiveMarks2125.火土,undefined);}const p=partialMake({move:38485,index:1});timer(p,1,'攻击伤害免疫');assert.throws(()=>turn(p,38485,20117),/Q-4930-001/);});

success.name: 4930火土提升唯一最高异常抗性到100，平手及0不提；忽略50%攻击减伤仍不越过攻击免疫
success.assertion: test('4930火土提升唯一最高异常抗性到100，平手及0不提；忽略50%攻击减伤仍不越过攻击免疫',()=>{for(const chances of[[55,18],[50,50],[0,0]]){const s=make({move:38485,index:1});mark(s,0,'火土');s.fighters[0].build.resistance.slots=[{name:'中毒',chance:chances[0]},{name:'烧伤',chance:chances[1]},{name:'',chance:0}];assert.equal(E.GEAR.resistanceChance(s.fighters[0],'中毒'),chances[0]>chances[1]?1:chances[0]/100);assert.equal(E.GEAR.resistanceChance(s.fighters[0],'烧伤'),chances[1]/100);}const s=make({move:38485,index:1}),z=make({move:38485,index:1});mark(s,0,'火土');timer(s,1,'攻击伤害减免',{fraction:.5});timer(z,1,'攻击伤害减免',{fraction:.5});turn(s,38485,20117);turn(z,38485,20117);assert.ok(sum(s)>sum(z));const p=make({move:38485,index:1});mark(p,0,'火土');timer(p,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(p,38485,20117);assert.equal(sum(p),0);});

success.name: 4930三项真实清除及失败各100魂印回复可独立核验，成功后的异常奖励明确待答回滚
success.assertion: test('4930三项真实清除及失败各100魂印回复可独立核验，成功后的异常奖励明确待答回滚',()=>{const s=partialMake({move:38485,index:1,hp:5000});s.fighters[1].effects={};for(const n of['金','木','水'])mark(s,0,n);timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)E.SOULS.registry[2125].abilities.entryRewards(c);},()=>turn(s,38485,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,5300);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperorCleanup2125.map(x=>x.success),[false,false,false]);const p=partialMake({move:38485,index:1,hp:5000});mark(p,0,'金');assert.throws(()=>observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)E.SOULS.registry[2125].abilities.entryRewards(c);},()=>turn(p,38485,20117)),/Q-4930-004/);assert.equal(p.round,1);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].hp,5000);});

interaction.assertion: test('4930火土提升唯一最高异常抗性到100，平手及0不提；忽略50%攻击减伤仍不越过攻击免疫',()=>{for(const chances of[[55,18],[50,50],[0,0]]){const s=make({move:38485,index:1});mark(s,0,'火土');s.fighters[0].build.resistance.slots=[{name:'中毒',chance:chances[0]},{name:'烧伤',chance:chances[1]},{name:'',chance:0}];assert.equal(E.GEAR.resistanceChance(s.fighters[0],'中毒'),chances[0]>chances[1]?1:chances[0]/100);assert.equal(E.GEAR.resistanceChance(s.fighters[0],'烧伤'),chances[1]/100);}const s=make({move:38485,index:1}),z=make({move:38485,index:1});mark(s,0,'火土');timer(s,1,'攻击伤害减免',{fraction:.5});timer(z,1,'攻击伤害减免',{fraction:.5});turn(s,38485,20117);turn(z,38485,20117);assert.ok(sum(s)>sum(z));const p=make({move:38485,index:1});mark(p,0,'火土');timer(p,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(p,38485,20117);assert.equal(sum(p),0);});
